name: security-image-metadata-publication-review
intent: Sensitive image metadata retained through transformation and public delivery
artifacts: Upload metadata policy, transformation pipeline, EXIF/XMP fields, original/thumbnail routes and recipient entitlement.
trace: Follow protected metadata through original, resized and cached variants. Establish whether the publisher intentionally authorizes the destination audience to receive it.
experiment: Use an owned image with synthetic location/identity metadata and compare public/authorized output variants; do not collect real-user location data.
disproof: Metadata presence is not automatically a confidentiality violation; public photographer attribution and owner-requested original downloads can be intended.
repair: Strip/protect sensitive fields according to policy across variants, preserving intended attribution and image quality.
branch_decisions: Inspect the delivered derivative, original-download path and CDN cache separately. Stripping visible EXIF fields may leave thumbnails, XMP or other containers; a server filename is not necessarily original metadata. Confirm a synthetic classified field survives the actual public delivery path, and distinguish deliberately published attribution from private location/device data.
